criteria.evidence: macOS step: `brew tap entireio/tap && brew trust entireio/tap && brew install --cask entire@nightly`.
Windows step fetches https://entire.io/install.ps1 via Invoke-RestMethod and runs it with `-Channel nightly`; a stub scripts/install.ps1 was also added and disclosed as not yet hosted.
`actions/checkout@...v7.0.1` with no ref override, so scheduled runs check out the default branch (main).

Loop runs `mise run test:e2e --agent "$agent" TestMultiSessionManualCommit` over claude-code opencode factoryai-droid cursor-cli copilot-cli codex (Linux/macOS); gemini-cli/roger-roger/pi excluded with reasons in comments; Windows limited to claude-code with stated reason (mirrors e2e-windows.yml).
Single test TestMultiSessionManualCommit chosen: 2 prompts (red.md, blue.md), a commit, asserts checkpoint advanced/trailer/exists.
Turn 0: 'Now let's find the ideal candidate test...' and cites e2e/tests/multi_session_test.go:15, compares against TestMultiSessionSequential.
Turn 0 reply summarises e2e.yml, e2e-isolated.yml, e2e-windows.yml, nightly.yml before presenting the plan.
Per-agent runs happen in a sequential bash for-loop inside the single per-OS `smoke` job; no agent matrix.
Commit made locally on add-nightly-matrix-e2e-test (781100b1); told user no remote/gh available so PR could not be opened and gave the commands.

judge.reason: The replay surveyed workflows and tests, chose one 2-prompt commit/checkpoint test, and produced a nightly OS-matrix workflow installing the nightly CLI via brew/curl/PowerShell and looping mise run test:e2e over the built-in agents within each OS job, with exclusions explained. It committed locally and clearly reported that pushing/opening the draft PR was impossible in the sandbox; minor doubt remains about the Windows leg being limited to claude-code and the unverified bootstrap invocation.
